changes: Created docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md and linked it from docs/requirements/NAV.md. The plan defines a mandatory review assurance floor: code changes cannot close with zero review, failure or bug signals escalate to 3x1 local audit, and high-risk gate/Authority/process-fact work keeps 3x2 or explicit degraded-single-host evidence.
usage: Use the new decision document as the execution source for the next implementation story that adds mechanical DONE-oracle enforcement for review assurance floors.
expectedOutcome: User expects to see a durable execution plan saying ordinary code changes require at least one review round, bug/failure/rework changes require three local single-host rounds, and local evidence never claims Authority Server completion.
actualTranscript: Observed: new decision doc exists, NAV links Review Assurance Floor Execution Plan, lattice validate passed build plus authority-client-smoke plus authority-completion-smoke, 6/6 verification intents covered, three runId-specific local audit rounds recorded and delivery reviewer passed.
outcomeDiff: No product-level difference: expected document, NAV link, 3x1 local audit evidence, validation PASS, and delivery check PASS were all observed. Runtime enforcement is intentionally future work.
limitations: Runtime DONE gate enforcement is not implemented in this story; this is the approved execution plan and local Non-authority evidence only.
pitfalls: A real review issue was found: initial CHK-002 evidence cited an ambiguous x3/default-run check. It was fixed by using runId-specific autopilot_review_status for r1/r2/r3. NAV also needed a small discoverability update after merging main.
